_comment: ChiSurf package manager, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over PackageManagerModel (gui/package_model.py): one panel per page of the Qt tab widget, the operation log and Refresh All under them (drawn by gui/package_app.py), and the in-app confirm / text-entry dialog the Qt tool asked with message boxes. Tables are data_table sections; the Qt tables allowed several selected rows, a data_table selects one.
